description: Fetches ISO 3166-1 country code data from the ISO Online Browsing Platform (www.iso.org/obp), including alpha-2, alpha-3, numeric codes, and subdivision information.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_country: 检索单个国家的ISO 3166-1代码信息，需要country_code参数; 参数: country_code; 必填: country_code

country_code.description:
Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., US, DE, NL, FR, JP, CN).
Required when function is 'get_country'. Case-insensitive.
